name: hou_mcp_structural_affinity
description: Query environment-structural affinity data. Given an environment name, returns the preferred structural roles (boosted +0.10 confidence), irrelevant roles (capped at 0.50), and the raw affinity score (+1/0/-1) for any role/environment pair. Useful for understanding why a classification confidence changed after environment adjustment.
python_code:
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.structure import get_environment_structural_affinity
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Structural_Affinity(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_structural_affinity"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("environment",  "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("role",         "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_output("preferred_roles",  "string")
        self.add_output("irrelevant_roles", "string")
        self.add_output("affinity_score",   "float")
        self.add_output("environments",     "string")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        environment = str(inputs.get("environment") or "")
        role        = str(inputs.get("role") or "")

        affinity = get_environment_structural_affinity()

        preferred  = affinity.preferred_roles(environment)
        irrelevant = affinity.irrelevant_roles(environment)
        score      = affinity.affinity_score(role, environment) if role else 0.0
        envs       = affinity.supported_environments()

        self.log_info(
            f"Structural affinity [{environment}]: "
            f"{len(preferred)} preferred, {len(irrelevant)} irrelevant roles"
        )
        if role:
            label = "preferred" if score > 0 else ("irrelevant" if score < 0 else "neutral")
            self.log_info(f"  Role '{role}' is {label} in {environment!r}")

        return {
            "preferred_roles":  json.dumps(preferred,  sort_keys=True),
            "irrelevant_roles": json.dumps(irrelevant, sort_keys=True),
            "affinity_score":   score,
            "environments":     json.dumps(envs, sort_keys=True),
            "exec_out":         True,
        }

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Structural_Affinity
